timeline.heading: Securities Markets Code referral
timeline.body: Bill referred post Winter Session. Initial stakeholder mapping completed.

timeline.heading: Expert depositions
timeline.body: Former SEBI chairman M. Damodaran deposed. RBI, NSE, BSE, CDSL representatives heard.

timeline.heading: Industry and civil society round
timeline.body: CII, FICCI, and investor associations heard. Draft interim observations circulated.

timeline.heading: Ministry deposition (ongoing)
timeline.body: Ministry of Finance being deposed on consolidation rationale and implementation roadmap.

timeline.heading: Report drafting
timeline.body: Expected to recommend phased commencement and stronger transitional provisions.

timeline.heading: Report tabled
timeline.body: Final report to be tabled in Parliament with recommendations.

timeline.heading: Mental health infrastructure review
timeline.body: Significant gaps found in district mental health programme funding across 18 states.

timeline.heading: Antimicrobial resistance study
timeline.body: Expert panel on AMR convened. Tighter prescription protocols recommended.

timeline.heading: Cancer care affordability hearings
timeline.body: AIIMS, Tata Memorial deposed. Gaps found in PMJAY coverage for cancer therapies.

timeline.heading: Ministry deposition on cancer interventions
timeline.body: Ministry being deposed on affordable cancer care interventions and Jan Aushadhi expansion.

timeline.heading: Report on cancer care
timeline.body: Expected to recommend inclusion of five key cancer drugs in PMJAY and expansion of radiotherapy centres.

timeline.heading: Pharmacy Bill scrutiny
timeline.body: Pre-legislative scrutiny of upcoming Pharmacy Bill covering online pharmacy regulation.

timeline.heading: AI regulation framework study
timeline.body: Examined EU, UK, Singapore AI governance models. NASSCOM and civil society heard.

timeline.heading: Deepfake and digital harm hearings
timeline.body: Meta, Google, X deposed. Recommended mandatory deepfake labelling.

timeline.heading: DPDP Rules review begins
timeline.body: Internet Freedom Foundation and MeitY heard. Concerns on vague consent manager definitions.

timeline.heading: AI governance deliberations
timeline.body: Deliberating on sector-agnostic vs sector-specific AI regulatory framework.

timeline.heading: DPDP Rules recommendations
timeline.body: Expected to recommend clearer consent manager criteria and longer compliance timelines.

timeline.heading: AI governance report
timeline.body: Likely to recommend soft-touch AI governance with mandatory impact assessments.

timeline.heading: MGNREGA utilisation certificates
timeline.body: ₹4,200 crore in unspent funds against pending wage liabilities found across 14 states.

timeline.heading: Defence procurement irregularities
timeline.body: CAG findings on HAL and DRDO delays reviewed. Penalty clauses recommended.

timeline.heading: PM-Kisan expenditure audit
timeline.body: Examining beneficiary duplication, ineligible recipients, and Aadhaar seeding gaps.

timeline.heading: Report on PM-Kisan
timeline.body: Expected to recommend real-time de-duplication and recovery of ₹1,800 crore in ineligible transfers.

timeline.heading: Digital India audit
timeline.body: CAG performance audit of BharatNet Phase II delays and UMANG app adoption metrics.
